name: Ken Griffin

lean.basis: Calls himself a "Ronald Reagan Republican"; has given hundreds of millions to Republican candidates and committees (about $100M in 2024, mainly to the Senate and House Republican super PACs). An establishment Republican: backed Rubio in 2016 and Haley in 2024, did not fund Trump's 2016 or 2024 campaigns, and criticizes his tariffs.

current_role: Founder and CEO of Citadel; founder of Citadel Securities
summary: Ken Griffin founded the hedge fund Citadel in 1990 and the market maker Citadel Securities, and moved both headquarters from Chicago to Miami in 2022. One of the largest Republican donors, he funds establishment Senate and House super PACs and candidates rather than Trump, whose tariffs he has called a step toward "crony capitalism". He has said he would back Marco Rubio in 2028.

connections.name: Donald Trump
connections.description: An establishment critic rather than a foe: Griffin called Trump's 2018 attacks on the Fed chair "completely inappropriate", Trump criticized him for skipping the 2020 China trade-deal signing, and Griffin did not fund Trump's 2024 campaign and calls his tariffs a "slippery slope to crony capitalism". He did meet Trump about donating in 2024.

connections.name: Zohran Mamdani
connections.description: On April 15, 2026 Mamdani posted a video naming Griffin's $238 million penthouse to promote a new pied-à-terre tax; Griffin called it a "personal attack" that put him "in harm's way", and Citadel said it was reassessing its planned $6 billion Park Avenue headquarters tower. Mamdani refused to apologize.
